name: application-settle-step1
title: Step 1 (SETTLE) through the cold bulb, 20 kHz control
purpose: Bench plant of the inverter cases (ideal 400 V bus, 500 µH filter without chokes, grid behind 40 Ω, duty limits 0.05–0.95). OFF at t = 0, step 1 (SETTLE) at 10 ms, held to 1.3 s. The observer qualifies after its 1 s dwell; the inverter then synchronizes for 100 ms, starts the bridge at 50 % (PWM_WAIT) and holds PWM_SETTLE with the relay open. Checks the real step-1 sequence with the bridge switching at 50 ns resolution. About one hour of computing: run only on request (L1_LONG=1).
